title: Goedel-Prover: A Frontier Model for Open-Source Automated Theorem Proving
authors_zh: Yong Lin、Shange Tang、Bohan Lyu、Jiayun Wu、Hongzhou Lin、Kaiyu Yang、Jia Li、Mengzhou Xia、Danqi Chen、Sanjeev Arora、Chi Jin
paper_type_zh: 开放形式数学数据集、构造流程与证明器报告
best_for_zh: 适合构建 Lean 完整证明语料、自动形式化流程和验证器驱动的专家迭代。
one_line: Goedel-Prover releases large-scale informal/formal Lean statements and 29,750 complete proofs produced through compiler-verified expert iteration.
Goedel-Prover 公开大规模自然语言与 Lean 陈述，以及通过编译器核验的 29,750 条完整证明。
why: It exposes statement style, faithfulness checks, proof search, compiler verification, and cumulative SFT as distinct data-quality decisions.
inclusion_reason: The paper releases compiler-verifiable statement and whole-proof supervision and documents how dual formalization plus expert iteration produces it.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Formal theorem proving offers machine-checkable reasoning, but public Lean corpora contain far fewer natural-language-aligned statements and complete proofs than ordinary math corpora. The decision boundary is whether autoformalized statements preserve the source problem and whether a sampled whole proof actually compiles, not whether a natural-language judge finds it plausible.

Goedel-Prover trains two statement formalizers for different Lean styles, applies compilation plus faithfulness checks, and repeatedly samples and verifies whole proofs to expand the solved set. This is atlas-relevant because the released objects expose informal/formal alignment, proof text, stable identifiers, and a Lean terminal predicate; evaluation covers miniF2F, ProofNet, Lean Workbook, NuminaTest, and PutnamBench.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2502.07640v3; 2025 technical report; data object 1.64M public formal statements plus 29,750 released Lean Workbook proofs; evaluation surface formal theorem proving under Pass@N; collection note: both ungated Parquet schemas and actual records checked on 2026-07-14.

形式定理证明提供机器可检查的推理，但公开 Lean 语料中，与自然语言对齐的陈述和完整证明远少于普通数学语料。真正的决策边界是自动形式化陈述是否忠实于原题，以及采样的完整证明是否通过编译，而不是自然语言裁判觉得它是否像正确答案。

Goedel-Prover 训练两种不同风格的陈述形式化器，结合编译与忠实度检查，并反复采样、验证完整证明来扩大已解集合。它与本图谱直接相关，因为发布对象明确给出自然语言与形式语言对齐、证明文本、稳定标识和 Lean 终止判据；评测覆盖五类形式证明集合。

L4 事实：主来源为 2025 年 arXiv 第三版技术报告；数据对象为 164 万条公开形式陈述和 29,750 条 Lean Workbook 完整证明；评测表面是不同采样预算下的形式定理证明；2026-07-14 已检查两个无门槛 Parquet 的字段和真实记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Goedel-Prover treats formal statements and compiler-valid whole proofs as a growing supervision pool: two formalizers increase statement-style diversity, a model judge screens semantic faithfulness, Lean supplies the hard proof predicate, and each SFT prover discovers positives for the next round. The closest comparison is outcome-only theorem proving, but the public artifacts serialize statements and complete proof demonstrations for training, so instruction, demonstration, and rationale data is the primary category.

Google Scholar citations: 135（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Goedel-Prover%3A+A+Frontier+Model+for+Open-Source+Automated+Theorem+Proving&author=Yong+Lin&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes, two official ungated datasets were anonymously read. Dataset name: Goedel-Pset-v1 and Lean-workbook-proofs. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Goedel-LM/Goedel-Pset-v1 and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Goedel-LM/Lean-workbook-proofs. Scale: 1.64M formal statements in four shards; 29,750 complete Lean Workbook proofs. Record form: informal/formal statement pairs keyed by problem_id, and separate problem_id/full_proof records. File / storage format: Parquet train files with three-column statement and two-column proof schemas. Domains / languages: English informal mathematics and Lean 4 formal mathematics across olympiad, school, and undergraduate topics. Construction and filtering: dual autoformalization, Lean compilation, model-based faithfulness checks, Pass@16 whole-proof sampling, compiler verification, and eight cumulative expert iterations. License / access constraints: no dataset license tag was present; MIT applies to code only, so source and teacher-output rights require separate review. Intended use: SFT, verifier-backed proof-data expansion, formalization research, and theorem-prover evaluation.

Goedel-Prover 把形式陈述和编译通过的完整证明视为不断增长的监督池：两个形式化器增加陈述风格多样性，模型裁判筛查语义忠实度，Lean 提供硬证明判据，每一轮监督微调证明器再为下一轮发现新的正例。最接近的比较对象是只保留结果的定理证明，但公开产物序列化了陈述和完整证明示范，因此主类别是指令、示范与推理过程数据。

Google Scholar 引用数：135（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Goedel-Prover%3A+A+Frontier+Model+for+Open-Source+Automated+Theorem+Proving&author=Yong+Lin&hl=en）

开放数据集：是，两个官方无门槛数据集均已匿名读取。 数据集名称：Goedel-Pset-v1 与 Lean-workbook-proofs。 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Goedel-LM/Goedel-Pset-v1 和 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Goedel-LM/Lean-workbook-proofs。 规模：四个分片中的 164 万条形式陈述，以及 29,750 条完整证明。 记录形式：以题目标识连接的自然语言与形式陈述对，以及独立的题目标识与完整证明记录。 文件与存储格式：Parquet 训练文件，陈述数据三列，证明数据两列。 领域与语言：英文自然语言数学和 Lean 4 形式数学，覆盖竞赛、中小学和本科主题。 构造与过滤：双重自动形式化、Lean 编译、模型忠实度检查、每题十六次完整证明采样、编译核验和八轮累计专家迭代。 许可与访问约束：两个数据集均未标注许可；MIT 只适用于代码，来源与教师输出权利需单独审查。 预期用途：监督微调、验证器驱动的证明数据扩展、形式化研究和定理证明器评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1: Input: Numina informal problems and informal/formal pairs from Lean Workbook or Claude-generated annotations. Operation: Train two Qwen2.5-Coder-32B formalizers so the same source problem can be expressed in different Lean styles. Output and transition: Each informal problem receives candidate Lean 4 statements from both formalizers. Check / stop rule: Discard candidates that do not compile with the proof replaced by by sorry.

Step 2: Input: Compiling formal statements paired with their informal sources. Operation: Ask Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for four faithfulness/completeness judgments and compute the fraction marked appropriate. Output and transition: Valid statements enter the 1.78M-statement expert-iteration pool. Check / stop rule: Retain only statements with faithfulness/completeness score at least 0.5; drop a formalizer's outputs if none pass.

Step 3: Input: The current formal-statement pool and DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL for the initial round or the iter-k prover thereafter. Operation: Sample 16 complete proofs per statement and compile every candidate in Lean. Output and transition: Randomly retain one valid proof for each newly solved statement and add it to the cumulative SFT set. Check / stop rule: A statement contributes supervision only when at least one sampled proof compiles.

Step 4: Input: All accumulated statement-proof pairs. Operation: Fine-tune DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-Base, producing iter-(k+1), and repeat for eight expert iterations before evaluating under fixed Pass@N budgets. Output and transition: The final SFT prover, public statement data, and 29,750 Lean Workbook proofs form the reusable bundle. Check / stop rule: Track compiler-verified held-out performance and stop after the planned iteration budget; do not promote DPO/RL shortcuts as proof quality.

步骤一： 输入：Numina 自然语言题，以及来自 Lean Workbook 或教师标注的自然语言与形式陈述对。 操作：训练两个 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 形式化器，使同一道来源题能采用不同 Lean 风格表达。 输出与流转：每道自然语言题获得两个形式化器生成的候选 Lean 4 陈述。 检查与停止规则：把证明替换为空占位后仍不能编译的候选直接丢弃。

步骤二： 输入：能够编译并与自然语言来源配对的形式陈述。 操作：让 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 给出四次忠实度与完整性判断，计算被判为合适的比例。 输出与流转：有效陈述进入 178 万条陈述的专家迭代池。 检查与停止规则：只保留得分至少为 0.5 的陈述；某个形式化器没有通过项时就不保留其输出。

步骤三： 输入：当前形式陈述池，以及首轮证明器或后续第 k 轮证明器。 操作：每个陈述采样十六个完整证明，并在 Lean 中编译每个候选。 输出与流转：每个新解陈述随机保留一个有效证明，加入累计监督微调集合。 检查与停止规则：只有至少一个采样证明编译通过，陈述才能贡献监督数据。

步骤四： 输入：累计得到的全部陈述与证明对。 操作：从同一个基础模型监督微调得到下一轮证明器，共执行八轮，再按固定采样预算评测。 输出与流转：最终监督微调证明器、公开陈述数据和 29,750 条完整证明组成可复用包。 检查与停止规则：跟踪编译核验的留出性能并按计划轮数停止，不能把偏好学习中的捷径当作证明质量。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Whole-proof comparison. Goedel-Prover-SFT reaches 57.6% Pass@32 on miniF2F, versus 50.0% for DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL; at Pass@3200 the comparison is 62.7% versus 54.9%. Because both use whole-proof generation and the same benchmark, the result supports the combined statement/proof expansion recipe, but training data and hardware are not matched component by component.

Data and style ablations. The mixed Formalizer A+B training set reaches 57.6% on miniF2F, 15.2% on ProofNet, and 61.2% on NuminaTest, averaging 44.7%, versus averages 43.3% and 43.8% for either style alone. The paper also shows that adding Mathlib4 raises ProofNet from 13.2% to 15.6% but lowers miniF2F from 56.1% to 54.1%, exposing distribution tradeoffs rather than a uniformly better mixture.

完整证明比较。Goedel-Prover-SFT 在 miniF2F 的每题三十二次采样下达到 57.6%，而 DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 为 50.0%；扩大到每题三千二百次时，两者为 62.7% 和 54.9%。两者都采用完整证明生成并使用同一基准，因此结果支持陈述与证明扩展的组合流程，但训练数据和硬件没有逐组件匹配。

数据与风格消融。混合两种形式化风格的训练集在三个集合上达到 57.6%、15.2% 和 61.2%，平均 44.7%；只用单一风格时平均为 43.3% 或 43.8%。加入 Mathlib4 又把 ProofNet 从 13.2% 提高到 15.6%，却把 miniF2F 从 56.1% 降到 54.1%，说明数据混合存在分布权衡，而非一致提升。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier Lean provers used smaller public statement pools, private formalization sources, or reinforcement learning without releasing a comparable aligned corpus. Goedel-Prover changes the supervision pipeline by combining two formalization styles, a soft semantic screen, a hard Lean compiler predicate, and cumulative whole-proof expert iteration at million-statement scale. This is a direction signal because statement diversity and mechanically verified proof discovery become separate, auditable levers, while the public 29.7K proofs provide a concrete quality signal. Autoformalization, compiler checking, and expert iteration are not individually new; the contribution is their scale and composition, and the full 800K solved training pool described in the paper is not exposed as a single current dataset release.

早期 Lean 证明器通常使用更小的公开陈述池、私有形式化来源，或采用强化学习却不发布同等规模的对齐语料。Goedel-Prover 改变了监督流程：在百万陈述规模上组合两种形式化风格、软语义筛查、硬 Lean 编译判据和累计完整证明专家迭代。它形成方向信号，是因为陈述多样性与机器核验的证明发现成为两个可分别审计的杠杆，公开的 29,750 条证明也给出具体质量信号。自动形式化、编译检查和专家迭代本身都不新；贡献在于规模与组合，而且论文所述八十多万已解训练池目前没有作为一个完整数据集公开。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The public statement release and 29,750-proof release do not equal the complete 800K-plus solved pool described for training. Reuse must state which subset is actually available and avoid claiming full-recipe reconstruction.
  • The faithfulness/completeness filter is an LLM judgment, so a statement can compile yet encode a different theorem. Reuse should manually audit aligned pairs and test with independent judges.
  • Distribution shifts are material: Mathlib4 helps ProofNet but hurts olympiad-style sets, while DPO/GRPO can overproduce try, lengthen proofs, and reduce inference-time diversity.

• 公开陈述和 29,750 条证明并不等于论文训练所述八十多万完整已解池。复用时必须说明实际可得子集，不能声称完整重建配方。
  • 忠实度与完整性过滤来自语言模型判断，因此陈述可能能够编译却表达了不同定理。复用时应人工抽查对齐对，并使用独立裁判复核。
  • 分布偏移很明显：Mathlib4 改善 ProofNet 却损害竞赛集合，偏好或强化学习还会过度生成特定策略、拉长证明并降低推理时多样性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Goedel-Pset-v1 to study autoformalized statement diversity and Lean-workbook-proofs as an independently replayable whole-proof set. Pin Lean 4.9.0, Mathlib, dataset revisions, and identifiers; compile every proof, manually audit statement faithfulness, and separate in-domain Lean Workbook from held-out results. A successful reuse report gives compile rate, semantic-audit agreement, duplicate and contamination rates, per-source Pass@N, and compute; it must not infer dataset rights from the repository's MIT code license.

可用 Goedel-Pset-v1 研究自动形式化陈述多样性，并把 Lean-workbook-proofs 作为可独立回放的完整证明集合。应固定 Lean 4.9.0、Mathlib、数据修订和题目标识，编译每个证明，人工审查陈述忠实度，并把训练内 Lean Workbook 与留出结果分开。有效复用报告应给出编译率、语义审查一致率、重复与污染率、分来源采样成功率和计算量；不能从代码仓库的 MIT 许可推断数据权利。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The public statement schema is problem_id/formal_statement/informal_statement; the proof schema is problem_id/full_proof.
  2. The first statement shard has 433,149 rows, while the separate complete proof release has 29,750 rows.
  3. Two formalizers, compilation, and four semantic judgments create the statement pool before proof search begins.
  4. Eight expert iterations sample 16 whole proofs per statement and retain compiler-valid positives for cumulative SFT.
  5. Reuse needs pinned Lean/Mathlib, semantic audits, split decontamination, license review, and explicit disclosure that the full solved training pool is not one public artifact.

1. 公开陈述字段是题目标识、形式陈述与自然语言陈述；证明字段是题目标识与完整证明。
  2. 首个陈述分片有 433,149 行，独立的完整证明发布有 29,750 行。
  3. 两个形式化器、编译检查和四次语义判断先构造陈述池，之后才开始证明搜索。
  4. 八轮专家迭代为每个陈述采样十六个完整证明，并累计保留编译通过的正例做监督微调。
  5. 复用需要固定 Lean 与 Mathlib、语义审查、划分去污染、许可审查，并明确完整已解训练池不是单一公开产物。

value_zh.html: NuminaTest 在形式化后留出，但未记录针对每个基准的广泛文本级去污染。Lean Workbook 被明确同时作为训练数据与受监测的域内数据。

items: A Lean-compiling formal statement can be unfaithful to the original informal problem despite the model-based judge.
ProofNet and Mathlib4 have different distributions from olympiad-style data, and adding Mathlib4 helps one while hurting miniF2F.
DPO and GRPO improve Pass@32 but lengthen proofs, overproduce shortcut tactics, and yield less benefit at high inference budgets.
尽管有基于模型的评审，能通过 Lean 编译的形式语句仍可能对原始非形式问题不忠实。
ProofNet 与 Mathlib4 的分布不同于奥林匹克风格数据，加入 Mathlib4 对其一有帮助而对 miniF2F 有损害。
DPO 与 GRPO 提高 Pass@32，但拉长证明、过度产生捷径 tactics，并在高推理预算下收益更少。

value.html: No dataset license tag was present in either official Hugging Face record on 2026-07-14; the code repository is MIT, which does not settle dataset, source-problem, or teacher-output rights.

value.html: informal problem -> dual autoformalization -> Lean compile and faithfulness checks -> 16 proof samples -> compiler validation -> one retained proof -> cumulative expert iteration -> public statement/proof Parquet.
